exposure: receiving support and guidance from health care providers
cohort: The study included 478 immediate postpartum mother-newborn pairs from Debre Tabor Comprehensive Specialized Hospital.
finding: The prevalence of timely initiation of breastfeeding was 73.7%, and factors significantly associated included being multiparous, receiving counseling and support immediately after delivery, having no obstetric complications, and practicing rooming-in.
cross-section timing: Immediately postpartum, within one hour of birth
